name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2018-12-05.134.1) introduced by Sturt MP [Christopher Pyne](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/sturt/christopher_pyne) (Liberal), which means it passed. [Standing orders](https://www.peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/parliament-at-work/standing-orders/) are the procedural rules of parliament. ### Motion text > *That so much of the standing orders be suspended as would prevent the resumption of debate on the motion that the Treasury Laws Amendment (Prohibiting Energy Market Misconduct) Bill 2018 be read a second time being made an order of the day for a later hour.*
